pages.text: Pick a mode on the console:$(li)$(bold)Off$()$(li)$(bold)Listen$(): 2 kW$(li)$(bold)Transmit$(): 40 kW for 3 min$(li)$(bold)Boost$(): 60 kW for 90 s

pages.title: Listen
pages.text: Every 90 s it catches a broadcast: phase advisories, a census of nearby stations, relay chatter.$(br2)Shown in the log and to players within 12 blocks.

pages.title: Transmit
pages.text: Once a day, in the Overworld, with a dish under open sky. One reward when it finishes.$(br2)Boost gives the same reward in half the time.

pages.title: Power
pages.text: Your grid, with batteries, must cover the full draw on top of everything else.$(br2)A refused start costs nothing. $(danger)If power or the dish fails mid-way, it aborts with no reward$() and the day's slot is spent.

pages.title: Warming Up
pages.text: Confirm $(bold)SIGNAL DETECTABLE$() first. The prompt shows $(bold)Grid ramping up$() while a load-following $(l:reactor/operation)reactor$(/l) climbs; Confirm works at $(bold)Grid ready$().$(br2)It lapses after 60 s.

pages.title: Heard
pages.text: Every transmission is heard. $(danger)Late in the collapse, Architects gather near a dish that transmits often.$()$(br2)Boost is louder. It fades over a few days.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA thanks you for staying in touch.$()
